events.title: Anthropic introduced Claude Duet as a proactive Always-on Agent research preview
events.verification_notes: Read the official 21 October Anthropic product announcement and release notes. Claude Duet is a waitlist research preview for US Pro and Max, with cloud VM, connected-app checks and approval gates; the official page does not establish production HA or SLA. No Anthropic feed exists in the current 13-source collector configuration, so this is a known source gap, not a proven defect in an enabled feed. Phase 4 adds an official Claude sitemap monitored source; capture depends on official sitemap lastmod coverage and must be verified by future real fetches. The official Claude product announcements listing is now an explicit monitored source, but capture must be demonstrated in a real ingestion artifact.

events.title: AWS documented runtime discovery of approved MCP and A2A capabilities through Agent Registry
events.verification_notes: Opened the first-party AWS technical article dated 20 October in the site timezone; the official RSS item provides 2026-10-20T16:22:24Z, which converts to 21 October Beijing. The post describes Discover/Instantiate/Execute, approved capability descriptors, and separate credential handling. This is a reference architecture and not measured evidence of cross-vendor universal interoperability.

events.title: OpenHands released software-agent-sdk v1.57.0 with per-conversation runtime configuration
events.verification_notes: Read the official GitHub release tag v1.57.0, published 2026-10-21T15:39:56Z (21 October Beijing). Release notes list per-conversation runtime choice/settings, SDK lifecycle declarations and cipher-key rotation safety. This verifies release content, not all deployments or production throughput.
